title: Director, Program Management
Director, Technical Program Management
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is looking for a director to help lead GitHub’s Technical Program Management team in our Engineering organization. You should be an ambitious, passionate, technical, and collaborative leader with a strong background in empowering high performing teams and an ability to deliver results through technical programs. 


The Director, TPM will strengthen TPM's role as a trusted integrator, driving clarity, accountability, and execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives. They will help teams frame problems, align stakeholders, and accelerate decision-making while raising the effectiveness of TPMs and scaling their influence across the company. This director will foster a culture of ownership, bias for action, and operational excellence, ensuring execution remains tightly aligned with strategic priorities. 


Responsibilities

Opportunity and Solutions Identification 

  • Demonstrates and builds experiences across multiple groups or divisions. Leads and coaches teams to develop problem statements and form hypotheses for products and services across divisional boundaries to address highly complex business, program, customer needs, and/or market opportunities; identifies dependencies of other features. 

  • Determines and leads process improvements to quickly scope insights, and drives change management initiatives. Uses industry understanding to direct teams to ensure alignment between the customer, the market, internal stakeholders, senior leadership, and the goals and strategy of GitHub. 

  • Holds teams accountable for collaborating with others (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Design) to ensure that they can satisfy customer requirements. Provides expertise to help teams validate the market size and opportunity of greatest value for the company. Facilitates collaboration between their team and other partner teams to bring about solutions. 

 

Program Planning and Success 

  • Provides expertise to help teams define the multiple program goals and prioritization for the products and services they own. Guides teams to translate the needs of the organization and other teams into program goals and prioritize deliverables based on data insights.  

  • Guides teams to engage in active risk management (proactive and reactive) to identify risks and propose mitigations for risks using data (e.g., telemetry, usage, net satisfaction, customer satisfaction). 

  • Coaches teams to define success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., Objectives and Key Results [OKRs], Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as quality and performance) of products, services and works with engineering to ensure needed telemetry is developed. Provides expert knowledge to help teams deeply understand the return on investment. 

  

Program/Service Development 

  • Acts as a subject matter expert in orchestrating and integrating efforts for the development and implementation process of product, services on large cross functional projects with internal teams and external partners. Drives teams to collaborate and coordinate across teams and perspectives to ensure alignment on product management and release, including tradeoffs, adjustments, and improvements as feasible. 

  • Guides teams to partner with the engineering team to contribute, prioritize, and deliver on the roadmap for product, service. Drives teams to understand the value proposition for the feature(s)/feature areas and answer technical questions on the feature(s)/feature areas they own.  

  • Guides teams to justify capacity requirements and advocate for the right resource allocation. Partners with the Engineering team to know the feature capabilities in alignment with the goal updates and associated tradeoffs. 

  • Guides teams tracking, coordinating, and communicating end-to-end project schedules for products, services. Ensures teams establish and monitor processes, and hold other stakeholders accountable for following the established schedule and processes. 

  • Guides teams when tracking and managing dependencies to enable cohesive, connected user scenarios, and to avoid issues and mitigate risks. Coaches teams to make adjustments or course corrections when projects are not aligned to schedules or goals. 

  • Drives teams to develop the staging and implementation plan for piloting/release in alignment with Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for products, services, its development timeline, and the introduction to the different programs. Ensures teams collaborate with stakeholders to monitor progress and adjust as needed. 

  • Helps teams lead governance programs and processes to ensure that specific performance requirements and standards are met throughout the development lifecycle (e.g., quality, compliance, privacy, security, safety, accessibility). 

 

Continuous Improvement 

  • Provides expertise to help teams partner with others to collect performance metrics (e.g., Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as usage, quality, speed, and cost), monitor and report on progress (e.g., business reviews), and derive insights that lead to productive courses of action. 

  • Ensures teams share insights with Engineering and other partners. Leads teams to form hypotheses to technical needs, perform experiments, and iterate to drive improvement in specific performance metrics that have measurable impact. 


Qualifications

Required Qualifications 

  • 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years experience in managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years people management experience.
  • 4+ years experience designing, building, or supporting software systems. 

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400.00 - USD $372,300.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

title: Director, Technology Program Management
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

The Director of Technology Program Management (TPM) for Infrastructure Products & Services (Infrastructure) within the Global Product Organization (GPO) serves as a trusted advisor, partner, and source of leverage to the Infrastructure organization. The Director will help drive and scale cross-functional initiatives, as well as build deep partnerships across the company, analyze nuanced issues, and synthesize data to strategically execute technical program deliverables on time and within budget. The Director will expedite decision-making by distilling complex issues into clear, actionable choices for leadership, bringing structure to complex programs, operationalizing big ideas, and navigating roadblocks to deliver results. They will act as a consultant, assessing challenges and synthesizing input from stakeholders across the organization to drive targeted decisions. They will focus on impact, moving swiftly from one high-value initiative to the next with an eye on business success. This role requires an individual who collaborates well and is able to drive results through others, building trust-based relationships internally and externally. They will resolve complex situations and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously, appropriately prioritizing long-term projects with the urgency of immediate demands. The Director needs to demonstrate a deep understanding of Equinix Infrastructure products and services, development processes and operating models, and must possess strong business acumen, communication, research, and data analysis skills.


Responsibilities

Senior Technical Program Management and Strategic Product Portfolio Planning:

  • Lead cross-functional enterprise projects and initiatives, providing technical program management and coordinating efforts among different teams while ensuring project milestones are met on time and within budget
  • Lead technical program management (TPM) team and oversee critical initiatives with major cross-functional dependencies
  • Expedite decision-making by distilling complex issues into clear, actionable choices for leadership, bring structure to complex programs, operationalize big ideas, and navigate roadblocks to deliver results
  • Act as a consultant, assessing challenges and synthesizing input from stakeholders across the organization to drive targeted decisions
  • Serve as liaison on technical program management services to the executive leadership team to ensure stakeholder and business alignment
  • Build and manage a technical program management environment to ensure effective execution of product strategy and enable strong partnership across IPS for delivery
  • Collaborate with the GPO and Interconnection Program Management Offices (PMOs) to ensure alignment on standards and best practices, and to develop innovative approaches to scale the Infrastructure TPM services
  • Collaborate closely with the SVP Infrastructure Products & Services and chief of staff to identify areas of opportunity for process improvement, strategy development, and overall improved effectiveness and efficiency
  • Work closely with cross functional leaders to track resource allocation and utilization for portfolio projects and provide input to the annual budget planning process on major IPS initiatives and programs
  • Lead the strategic planning and execution of the Infrastructure product portfolio roadmap, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and market trends
  • Coordinate and facilitate monthly and quarterly business reviews to ensure strategic alignment and accountability
  • Identify and spearhead high-impact programs that enhance business growth, operational efficiency, and customer experience
  • Create and maintain internal and external roadmaps, they reflect current priorities and effectively communicate with key stakeholders
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with program delivery, implementing proactive measures to ensure project success

Strategic Initiatives

  • Analyze complex business challenges and innovative, data-driven solutions that align with organizational goals
  • Develop and oversee comprehensive project plans, timelines, and resource allocations to ensure timely and successful initiative delivery
  • Engage stakeholders at all levels to execute initiatives that impact profit and loss (P&L)
  • Prepare and present insightful reports and dashboards that provide visibility into program performance and operational metrics
  • Optimize performance and drive efficiency by establishing repeatable processes
  • Optimize processes to ensure continuous improvement to drive process quality and productivity, ensuring consistency and efficiency across standards

Team Leadership:

  • Build and lead a high-performance team of approximately 7-10 employees focused on agile product development and strategic impact, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning within the Infrastructure Products & Services ecosystem
  • Explore and implement AI-driven and other tools and technologies to enhance program management processes, data analysis, and decision-making
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, encouraging their development, and promoting a high-performance work environment
  • Execute performance management of team members, including disciplinary actions and hire/fire decisions/recommendations

Qualifications

Knowledge and Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in program management, business strategy & operations or consulting within a high growth technology-focused enterprise
  • 3+ years of experience managing a team. Prefer experience managing a globally distributed or remote team
  • Proven track record of managing complex programs in the product life cycle and delivering results in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficient in strategic planning, financial analysis, and data analytics to drive informed decision-making for organizational growth
  • Experience in leveraging AI tools for project management & operational efficiency is a plus
  • Success building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influencing and collaborating in cross-functional environments
  • Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Business Administration, or Technology area; advanced degree preferred

Skills and Attributes:

  • Dynamic leader with business acumen and a proven ability to drive initiatives in the product life cycle and influence crossfunctional teams throughout the organization
  • Excellent communication including business writing, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization
  • Leadership capabilities to recruit talent and building a high-performance team
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive consensus among diverse stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making under pressure
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment and adapt to changing business needs and priorities
  • Have a growth mindset and be open to feedback and continuous improvement, with a proactive approach to personal and professional development
  • Think out of the box and help break the barriers to enable the team to go fast
  • Be the inspirational leader who empowers teams
  • Lead team with a servant leadership empath

title: Director, Portfolio, Resourcing and Transformation
location: Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States of America
description:
About the role

At AstraZeneca, we’re not afraid to do things differently. We’re building a new kind of organization to reset expectations of what a bio-pharmaceutical company can be. This means we’re opening up new ways to work, pioneering ground-breaking methods and bringing cross-functional teams together.

Biologics Engineering (BE) and Oncology Targeted Discovery (OTD) are pivotal organizations of over 1,000 people building the AstraZeneca portfolio across Biopharmaceuticals, Oncology and Infectious Diseases. With our ambition of delivering 20 new medicines by 2030, we must decide clearly where to invest our scientific capacity, bring AI into how we discover and develop medicines, and build next-generation talent.

This role sits where science, portfolio and transformation meet. You will shape how our scientific capacity is allocated across therapy areas, and how we decide what to start, continue, slow or stop. And you will lead strategic and transformation projects, including bringing AI into how we work, with direct exposure to senior scientific and functional leadership.

The ideal candidate combines analytical difficulty with the standing to align senior leaders who do not report to them. They are as comfortable facilitating a decision between Vice Presidents as they are building the numbers that make that decision possible, and they hold both to the same standard.

You will be responsible for

1. Portolio resource allocation and decision-making.

  • Run the resource allocation process with leadership teams and therapy area representatives, starting in BE, with scope to extend across the wider organization over time.
  • Partner with the teams that produce resourcing actuals to improve existing reports, put the numbers in context, and turn them into inputs for decisions, so that allocation is decided rather than left to drift.
  • Ensure new work starts only where capacity exists or a named release is agreed, and that work is slowed or stopped through scheduled reviews and clear triggers, in partnership with the leaders who own those decisions.
  • Keep a clear record of allocation decisions and their expected effect on capacity and check the delivered effect against actuals.
  • Evolve the methodology, rules and forums as needs change and adapt them as new parts of the organization come into scope.

2. Strategic projects and transformation

  • Lead high-impact strategic projects for the leadership teams of BE and OTD, from framing the question through to recommendation and implementation.
  • Drive delivery of AI transformation programs: turn ambition into a clear roadmap, and set up the governance, cadence and reporting that keep it on track.
  • Bring senior leaders across departments behind shared priorities, and resolve interdependencies, resourcing questions and decisions as they arise.
  • Projects may also include operating model and organizational design choices, evaluating new capabilities and technology platforms, building investment cases, and portfolio and competitive analyses that inform where to focus.
  • Track delivery and value against agreed objectives, connect initiatives to portfolio and resourcing plans, and bring risks and decisions to sponsors early.
  • Assemble and lead cross-functional project teams and develop the people in them.
  • Build outcomes into ongoing ways of working and help what works spread across the wider organization.

3. Leadership and organizational effectiveness

  • Shape the governance cadence of the leadership teams you support agendas, pre-reads, and decisions and actions followed through to completion.
  • Track and report progress against goals and scorecard critical metrics, and flag risks to delivery early.
  • Own recurring operating processes end to end, so they run reliably without critical issue, and keep simplifying them.
  • Prepare executive-ready materials for senior leadership.
  • Partner with Finance, Portfolio and Capacity Management, HR and Communications to keep portfolio, resourcing and headcount views aligned.
  • Support internal communications and organizational effectiveness priorities, including engagement and employee feedback, and turn themes into actions.

Essential qualifications and experience

  • Bachelors Degree required with 10+ years of experience or Masters or MBA with 8+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, consulting or a comparable R&D environment, including portfolio, strategy or transformation roles.
  • A track record of running resource allocation, portfolio prioritization or capacity planning processes that senior leaders relied on to make decisions.
  • Has led to strategic projects from problem framing to implementation, working directly with senior collaborators.
  • Has led a cross-functional transformation program and aligned senior leaders without direct authority.
  • Confident with capacity and financial data, with close attention to detail on forecasts, budgets and variances.
  • Turns complex information into clear recommendations and presents them with confidence to senior leadership.
  • Builds trust: an active listener with cultural sensitivity, discretion with confidential information, and a commitment to AstraZeneca’s values.
  • Works well with ambiguity and pace, acts without complete information, and adapts as priorities change.

Desirable

  • Understanding of drug discovery and development
  • Experience of AI, digital or data programs in an R&D setting
  • A background in strategy or management consulting roles

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $159,180.80 - $238,771.20. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility.

title: Vice President, Product & Technology PMO
description:
About Powerfleet
 Powerfleet (Nasdaq: AIOT; JSE: PWR) is a global leader in the artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) software-as-a-service (SaaS) mobile asset industry. With more than 30 years of experience, Powerfleet unifies business operations through the ingestion, harmonization, and integration of data—regardless of source—and delivers actionable insights to help companies meet their strategic objectives around Safety, Compliance, Efficiency and Sustainability. Our people-first culture and relentless innovation empower customers to achieve measurable, sustainable business improvements. Powerfleet serves over 2.6 million subscribers across more than 48,000 customers in 120 countries, with commercial operations across every major continent.

Position Summary

Powerfleet is seeking a Vice President, Product & Technology PMO to lead strategic portfolio management and execution across Product, Engineering, Technology, and enterprise transformation initiatives. This role will establish and drive the operating model, governance, and execution discipline needed to translate Powerfleet’s strategic priorities into measurable business and customer outcomes.

The Vice President, Product & Technology PMO will provide a single, integrated view of major initiatives across the organization, ensuring alignment around priorities, capacity, dependencies, investments, risks, and delivery. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and executive leadership, this role will strengthen portfolio decision-making, improve delivery predictability, and create clear accountability for outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a highly experienced technology and transformation leader who combines strong portfolio management expertise with business and financial acumen and thrives in a fast-paced, global environment.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy & Governance

  • Lead the Product & Technology PMO, including program management, project management, scrum, and delivery resources.

  • Establish and maintain portfolio governance across Product, Engineering, Technology, and enterprise transformation initiatives.

  • Develop and manage annual and quarterly planning, prioritization, capacity, and investment processes.

  • Create a single executive view of strategic initiatives, including milestones, dependencies, risks, investments, resource requirements, and expected outcomes.

  • Establish clear governance, decision-making, and accountability frameworks to support effective portfolio execution.

  • Ensure strategic investments remain aligned with organizational priorities and measurable business and customer outcomes.

Program & Delivery Excellence

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to improve roadmap execution, delivery predictability, and time-to-market.

  • Oversee major technology and enterprise transformation initiatives, ensuring effective planning, execution, and risk management.

  • Drive cross-functional execution across complex programs involving multiple business functions, technologies, geographies, and stakeholders.

  • Identify and proactively address organizational, resource, technology, and delivery dependencies that may impact strategic initiatives.

  • Establish consistent program and portfolio management practices while enabling teams to operate with appropriate flexibility and agility.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across portfolio execution.

Executive Reporting & Performance Management

  • Develop executive dashboards and KPIs that provide clear visibility into portfolio health, delivery performance, investment, business value, and customer outcomes.

  • Provide executive leadership with timely, actionable insights into portfolio progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.

  • Establish mechanisms to measure value realization and business outcomes associated with strategic technology investments.

  • Improve transparency and consistency in how program performance and portfolio health are communicated across the organization.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Partner with Finance and executive leadership on portfolio investment decisions, resource allocation, capacity planning, and value realization.

  • Develop frameworks to evaluate and prioritize investments based on strategic alignment, expected value, resource requirements, and organizational capacity.

  • Monitor portfolio investments and resource utilization to support informed decision-making and effective allocation of resources.

  • Balance strategic priorities with available capacity to improve organizational focus and execution.

PMO Transformation & Innovation

  • Build and continuously evolve a modern, outcome-driven PMO focused on enabling execution rather than traditional project reporting.

  • Leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and data-driven insights to improve planning, reporting, forecasting, risk management, and decision-making.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce administrative burden, and increase the speed and quality of portfolio decisions.

  • Establish scalable practices and tools that support Powerfleet’s continued growth and transformation.

Qualifications

Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role

Crusoe is scaling one of the fastest-growing global workplace and data center portfolios in the industry, with active real estate initiatives spanning San Francisco, Denver, London, Tel Aviv, Bellevue, and beyond, alongside a rapidly expanding global data center footprint. We're looking for a Senior Director, Real Estate & Portfolio Strategy to lead the strategy, execution, and financial management of our global co-location, manufacturing office and data center lease portfolio.

Reporting directly to the VP, DIG Operations, this role will be a critical partner in aligning our real estate strategy with business growth, headcount planning, employee experience, and long-term financial objectives across both corporate office, co-location, manufacturing and data center real estate. You'll work closely with our exclusive global brokerage partner, Legal, Finance, People, Data Center Operations, and business leaders to deliver thoughtful, data-driven real estate solutions that support Crusoe's continued expansion.

This is an exciting opportunity for a senior real estate leader who thrives on managing multiple concurrent transactions across office, manufacturing and data center/colocation portfolios, enjoys the financial and analytical side of commercial real estate, and wants to build scalable portfolio strategies, lease governance, and audit processes for a rapidly growing global company.

 

What You'll Be Working On

 

• Portfolio Strategy and Asset Management: by partnering with Finance, People, Workplace, and Data Center Operations leadership to translate hiring forecasts, capacity plans, and space/power utilization into real estate recommendations. Evaluate expansion, consolidation, renewal, and exit opportunities across global office and data center markets.

• Lease Portfolio Management: own the master lease abstract database across all locations, tracking key dates, terms, options, renewal windows, and obligations to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

• Lease Review & Abstracting: lead comprehensive lease review and abstracting for new and existing leases, including manufacturing office, data center, and cloud colocation agreements — abstracting key business, financial, and legal terms into standardized formats for portfolio-wide tracking and reporting.

• Transaction Execution: manage end-to-end real estate transactions — including new office and manufacturing leases, renewals, subleases, expansions, contractions, and terminations — in close partnership with our brokers and legal counsel.

• Cloud Colocation & Data Center Lease Management: lead ongoing lease management for cloud colocation and data center leases, including power/capacity commitments, service level agreements, interconnection terms, expansion rights, and hyperscaler lease administration.

• Critical Date Management: own the tracking and management of all critical lease dates across the portfolio — including notice periods, renewal and termination options, rent escalations, expansion/contraction windows, and compliance deadlines — ensuring proactive action ahead of key milestones.

• Financial Analysis & Reporting: build and maintain cash flow models, occupancy cost analyses, rent schedules, lease comparisons, escalations, and CAM reconciliations to support executive decision-making across office, manufacturing and data center portfolios.

• Executive Reporting: prepare business cases, portfolio updates, and executive presentations that translate complex lease and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

• Stakeholder Coordination: serve as the primary point of contact between Workplace, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Data Center Operations, and site leadership on all lease-related matters, including purchase order and approval workflows in Coupa.

• Broker & Transaction Management: serve as the relationship manager for Crusoe's global brokerage partner, leading lease negotiations, coordinating transaction strategy, and driving favorable business and financial outcomes across the portfolio.

• Compliance, Risk & Audit Management: track insurance requirements, certificates of occupancy, permits, and critical lease obligations across office and data center locations; manage lease and portfolio audits, proactively identifying and mitigating portfolio risks.

• Site Selection: partner with brokers and internal stakeholders on new market evaluations, including market analysis, site tours, financial comparisons, and lease execution for both office and manufacturing sites.

• Portfolio Systems & Process Improvement: lead the evaluation and implementation of a global lease administration platform while continuously improving portfolio reporting, documentation, and governance — including audit readiness — to support Crusoe's continued growth.

• Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance, or a related field.

• 15+ years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio strategy, lease administration, or commercial real estate transaction management, including experience with data center or cloud colocation leasing.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent lease transactions across multiple geographies and asset types, including office and data center/colocation.

• Strong financial acumen, including developing business cases, cash flow projections, occupancy cost analyses, lease economics, and executive recommendations.

• Hands-on experience with lease review, abstracting, and management, including tracking of critical dates, options, and obligations across a large, complex portfolio.

• Experience negotiating commercial lease terms in partnership with brokers and legal counsel, including colocation and data center-specific terms (power, SLAs, interconnection, expansion rights).

• Experience leading or supporting lease and portfolio audits, with a strong understanding of compliance and risk management practices.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners and executive leadership without direct authority.

• Experience implementing or administering lease management software is highly desirable.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets with strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex real estate and financial information for executive audiences.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving business priorities.

 

Bonus Points

Understanding the Security Community

Strategically seeks out influencers in the security and open source spaces to understand business drivers and community objectives. Anticipates future changes in the application security landscape, including the impact of AI on security research workflows and the emerging challenges of securing AI-generated code.

Building Trusted Relationships

Acts as a trusted and influential ambassador between the security community and GitHub's product, engineering, and marketing teams. Builds and maintains a broad, diverse network across security researchers, open source maintainers, and enterprise security teams. Utilizes deep understanding of community needs to share valuable insights, best practices, and technical know-how, maintaining thought leadership within the security community.

Internal Advocacy and Impact

CX Vision and Strategy

This leader will be responsible for four pillars of creating the world's best Customer Experience engine for the world's most advanced unstructured robotic solutions:

Pillar I: CX Product Innovation & Customer Obsession

Product Leadership: Directly manage one Product Manager to productize the end-to-end customer journey with the same rigor as hardware development.

Zero-Friction Mandate: Drive the strategy for "zero friction" scores by translating customer obsession into actionable product requirements and seamless onboarding experiences.

Pillar II: Portfolio & Technical Program Delivery

Methodology Mastery: Deep fluency in product management methodologies (Agile, journey mapping, discovery frameworks) and portfolio management best practices (governance, resource leveling, strategic road mapping).

Customer Obsession & Analytics: A relentless drive to advocate for the user, coupled with the analytical acumen to translate qualitative feedback and quantitative metrics into actionable product requirements.

description:
The Modular Manufacturing & Integration organization is leading an industry-defining transformation in how Google delivers technical infrastructure for the AI era. Transitioning away from conventional, on-site, purpose-built construction, our mission is to industrialize data center delivery through mass-assembled, standardized modules and off-site manufacturing.

By pushing labor-intensive assembly, systems integration, and quality testing upstream into controlled factory environments, we enable "square wave" capacity delivery—turning on gigawatt-scale AI compute, liquid cooling, power distribution, and network fabric with unprecedented velocity. Operating across AI Systems & Infrastructure (AI2), Google Data Centers (GDC), Systems & Manufacturing (ISM), and Google Global Infrastructure (GGI), our team defines the modular technical product and serves as the accountable business owner for industrializing and landing modular capacity globally.

As the Principal TPM of Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering, you will be the chief industrial architect responsible for translating Google’s modular infrastructure strategy into an executable, manufacturing reality. In this principal technical leadership role—with the charter to incubate the discipline and potentially scale a dedicated team over time—you will bridge the gap between design engineering, external contract manufacturing, and on-site field execution.

Your remit spans the entire physical and technical stack: structural modules, medium-to-low voltage power skids, liquid cooling distribution, and dense AI compute hardware. You will evaluate current field deployment and operations bottlenecks and establish scalable manufacturing processes with global contract manufacturers and fabricators. Your core mandate is simple yet radical: dramatically compress the timeline from factory gate to live AI compute, reduce complexity of assembly in manufacturing and in the field, and increase first pass yield/quality of the entire data center system.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Salary:

$172,000.00 - $237,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Role Summary 

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) Director will serve as the central orchestrator of large, complex module programs spanning Logic and Memory business units and key strategic customers (e.g., Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, Intel). This role requires a unique blend of technical depth in semiconductor process technologies, business acumen, and executive-level communication to drive program execution from concept through high-volume manufacturing enablement. The TPM will be the binding force across engineering, business development, CTO, and customer organizations — ensuring alignment, speed, and accountability at every stage. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Customer Program Ownership: Lead end-to-end program management for strategic customer engagements, including Technology Review Meetings (TRMs), yield improvement task forces, and cost reduction initiatives. Own program scoping, planning, risk management, and execution to plan of record. 
  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Prepare and present executive-level materials (slide decks, agendas, executive summaries) for meetings with customer VPs, CTOs, EVPs, and internal senior leadership. Represent Applied Materials with credibility and technical authority. 
  • Cross-Functional & Cross-BU Coordination: Drive alignment across multiple BUs (e.g., MDP, Etch, CTO, Logic Modules, Memory Modules), integrated development teams (IDTs), and cross-functional teams (CFTs) through structured weekly and monthly review cadences. 
  • Global Team Leadership: Coordinate program execution across US headquarters and international sites (Korea, Japan, Taiwan), managing across time zones, cultural contexts, and customer organizational structures. 
  • Risk & Decision Management: Proactively identify, assess, and retire program risks. Lead trade-off assessments and critical-path analysis to drive timely decision-making and escalation. 
  • Communication & Program Rigor: Maintain disciplined program cadence with detailed meeting minutes, action item tracking, milestone reporting, and weekly/monthly executive status updates. Ensure transparency on program performance, risks, gaps, and help needed. 
  • Business Development Integration: Partner with business development and strategy teams to shape new module engagement opportunities, translate customer requirements into actionable program plans, and align demo/development priorities with business objectives. 

Qualifications 

Required 

  • Education: BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a related semiconductor discipline. PhD preferred. 
  • Experience: 12+ years in the semiconductor industry with at least 5 years in technical program management, business management, or engineering leadership roles. 
  • Technical Depth: Strong working knowledge of advanced semiconductor process technologies — including but not limited to DRAM, Logic/Foundry nodes, BEOL integration, FEOL device engineering, etch, deposition, and module integration. 
  • Customer-Facing Experience: Proven track record of managing programs directly with major semiconductor manufacturers (IDMs, foundries, memory makers) at the VP/Director level and above. 
  • Program Management Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage large, multi-workstream programs with rigorous schedule, budget, and risk management discipline. 
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex technical topics into clear executive summaries and customer-ready presentations. 

Preferred 

  • Experience in semiconductor equipment or materials companies (e.g., Applied Materials, Lam Research, Tokyo Electron). 
  • Familiarity with Product Development Process (PDP) frameworks, phase-gate methodologies, and program management tools (e.g., Accolade/PDBoK). 
  • Bilingual (English/Korean, English/Mandarin, or English/Japanese) strongly preferred given the global customer base. 
  • Experience leading cost reduction, yield improvement, or technology roadmap alignment programs with customers. 
  • Track record of managing programs that span multiple technology nodes or product generations simultaneously. 

What Sets This Role Apart 

This is not a traditional TPM role. The ideal candidate will mirror the profile of our top-performing program leaders who: 

  • ✓  Own the full customer engagement lifecycle — from strategic planning through TRM execution and action item follow-through 
  • ✓  Operate seamlessly across technical depth and business strategy 
  • ✓  Build trusted relationships with customer executives (VP, CTO, Master-level) and internal senior leadership 
  • ✓  Drive urgency and accountability across globally distributed, cross-functional teams 
  • ✓  Communicate with precision — executive summaries, meeting minutes, and program dashboards are second nature

description:
About the role

At AstraZeneca, we’re not afraid to do things differently. We’re building a new kind of organization to reset expectations of what a bio-pharmaceutical company can be. This means we’re opening up new ways to work, pioneering ground-breaking methods and bringing cross-functional teams together.

Biologics Engineering (BE) and Oncology Targeted Discovery (OTD) are pivotal organizations of over 1,000 people building the AstraZeneca portfolio across Biopharmaceuticals, Oncology and Infectious Diseases. With our ambition of delivering 20 new medicines by 2030, we must decide clearly where to invest our scientific capacity, bring AI into how we discover and develop medicines, and build next-generation talent.

This role sits where science, portfolio and transformation meet. You will shape how our scientific capacity is allocated across therapy areas, and how we decide what to start, continue, slow or stop. And you will lead strategic and transformation projects, including bringing AI into how we work, with direct exposure to senior scientific and functional leadership.

The ideal candidate combines analytical difficulty with the standing to align senior leaders who do not report to them. They are as comfortable facilitating a decision between Vice Presidents as they are building the numbers that make that decision possible, and they hold both to the same standard.

You will be responsible for

1. Portolio resource allocation and decision-making.

Run the resource allocation process with leadership teams and therapy area representatives, starting in BE, with scope to extend across the wider organization over time.

Partner with the teams that produce resourcing actuals to improve existing reports, put the numbers in context, and turn them into inputs for decisions, so that allocation is decided rather than left to drift.

Ensure new work starts only where capacity exists or a named release is agreed, and that work is slowed or stopped through scheduled reviews and clear triggers, in partnership with the leaders who own those decisions.

Keep a clear record of allocation decisions and their expected effect on capacity and check the delivered effect against actuals.

Evolve the methodology, rules and forums as needs change and adapt them as new parts of the organization come into scope.

2. Strategic projects and transformation

Lead high-impact strategic projects for the leadership teams of BE and OTD, from framing the question through to recommendation and implementation.

Drive delivery of AI transformation programs: turn ambition into a clear roadmap, and set up the governance, cadence and reporting that keep it on track.

Bring senior leaders across departments behind shared priorities, and resolve interdependencies, resourcing questions and decisions as they arise.

Projects may also include operating model and organizational design choices, evaluating new capabilities and technology platforms, building investment cases, and portfolio and competitive analyses that inform where to focus.

Track delivery and value against agreed objectives, connect initiatives to portfolio and resourcing plans, and bring risks and decisions to sponsors early.

Assemble and lead cross-functional project teams and develop the people in them.

Build outcomes into ongoing ways of working and help what works spread across the wider organization.

3. Leadership and organizational effectiveness

Shape the governance cadence of the leadership teams you support agendas, pre-reads, and decisions and actions followed through to completion.

Track and report progress against goals and scorecard critical metrics, and flag risks to delivery early.

Own recurring operating processes end to end, so they run reliably without critical issue, and keep simplifying them.

Prepare executive-ready materials for senior leadership.

Partner with Finance, Portfolio and Capacity Management, HR and Communications to keep portfolio, resourcing and headcount views aligned.

Support internal communications and organizational effectiveness priorities, including engagement and employee feedback, and turn themes into actions.

Essential qualifications and experience

Bachelors Degree required with 10+ years of experience or Masters or MBA with 8+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, consulting or a comparable R&D environment, including portfolio, strategy or transformation roles.

A track record of running resource allocation, portfolio prioritization or capacity planning processes that senior leaders relied on to make decisions.

Has led to strategic projects from problem framing to implementation, working directly with senior collaborators.

Has led a cross-functional transformation program and aligned senior leaders without direct authority.

Confident with capacity and financial data, with close attention to detail on forecasts, budgets and variances.

Turns complex information into clear recommendations and presents them with confidence to senior leadership.

Builds trust: an active listener with cultural sensitivity, discretion with confidential information, and a commitment to AstraZeneca’s values.

Works well with ambiguity and pace, acts without complete information, and adapts as priorities change.

Desirable

Understanding of drug discovery and development

Experience of AI, digital or data programs in an R&D setting

A background in strategy or management consulting roles

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $159,180.80 - $238,771.20. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility.

Job ID: 10570635 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Description

Enterprise Engineering builds and operates the internal tools, platforms, and AI-powered services that enable over 1.5 million Amazonians to do their best work every day — from endpoint management and collaboration to innovative productivity experiences, all at massive global scale. We're seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-functional, company wide projects. This role requires working closely with product management to define strategy and requirements, collecting business and systems requirements from customers and business units, writing specifications, and leading development teams from design through delivery and subsequent operation. You will be expected to make appropriate trade-offs to optimize launch timelines, clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross-functional project teams. This position involves regular communication with senior management on status, risks, and product strategy. Excellent listening, writing skills, executive communication and very strong technical competency are essential.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects through multiple complete product development cycles, and will have a well-rounded technical background in current technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done. You will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop detailed functional and test specifications, schedule, and deploy new feature sets in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high product judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent, and leadership are essential to success in this role. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 5+ years of software development experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Description

Regulation Tech Assurance (RTA) is the team responsible for maintaining global regulatory compliance for all Amazon Stores, Devices, and Others to include payment and healthcare compliance. Additionally, RTA works to identify, analyze, and mitigate privacy risk identified through various compliance activities. 

We are seeking an experienced, self-motivated Principal Technical Program Manager with a background in privacy governance who will help identify, analyze, and prioritize privacy risk identified through a variety of sources across Amazon. This work will help drive leadership prioritization and reduced privacy compliance risk. The Principal Technical Program Manager will drive the strategy and manage the Hourglass program, which focuses on identifying, assessing, and remediating privacy obligations across all of Amazon. 

Key job responsibilities

- Drive end-to-end strategy and execution of Amazon Privacy's identification, assessment, and remediation framework for privacy obligations. 

- Manage and be accountable for privacy programs and/or projects to reduce privacy and compliance risk. 

- Work across various stakeholders to identify and evaluate customer needs and solutions.

- Lead various privacy compliance activities in order for Amazon to achieve and maintain compliance with legal, policy, and regulatory standards. 

- Continuously prioritize risk for service teams, security teams, and executive leadership.

- Work with Principal Engineers and others to develop technical risk mitigation strategies and approaches. 

- Communicate clearly and effectively both in writing and verbally with team members, stakeholders, and leadership.

- Integrate into various enterprise risk management processes.

- Establish program mechanisms, KPIs, and executive reporting.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Job ID: 10538041 | Amazon Development Center U.S., Inc.

Description

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.



Within AAIS, Amazon WorkSpaces is our cloud-based virtual desktop service that delivers secure, managed computing to over one million daily users across the globe, enabling organizations to provision, manage, and scale desktops with the reliability and performance their workforce depends on.



We are now at an inflection point. We are transforming traditional virtual desktops into Agentic WorkSpaces a new category of intelligent persona driven workspace experiences where AI agents operate continuously alongside humans orchestrating across foundation models maintaining enterprise governance and unlocking productivity at scale. This transformation spans multiple strategic pillars from next generation architecture modernization to AI powered capacity intelligence to entirely new product constructs all converging toward a single mission: making WorkSpaces the definitive venue for human AI teamwork in the enterprise.



We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the lifecycle of the most complex cross organizational programs driving this transformation. You will manage multiple concurrent workstreams spanning capacity intelligence, architecture modernization, agentic AI integration, persona-driven workspace experiences, and new product incubation stitching together a coherent narrative for executive leadership while proactively identifying and mitigating risk across every dimension.



This is not a role for someone who waits for problems to surface. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding methodical program execution and executive influence driving clarity where ambiguity exists building mechanisms that scale cross functionally and establishing trust with VPs and SVPs across AWS and AAIS leadership.

Key job responsibilities

• Multi-Workstream Program Ownership Own end to end delivery of significantly complex cross functional technical initiatives spanning multiple organizations across science engineering product business and data engineering. Drive simultaneous workstreams including agentic AI integration, workspace persona experiences, architecture modernization, capacity forecasting and optimization, and new product incubation with clear dependencies milestones and accountability. Stitch together disparate workstream narratives into a unified coherent story for leadership reviews QBRs and S Team updates.

• Proactive Risk Identification and Mitigation Develop mechanisms to surface risk early: capacity gaps service dependencies migration blockers science to production handoff delays and timeline slips before they escalate. Own escalation paths and drive resolution at the right level. You are escalated to, not escalating up. Build data driven risk models that quantify trade offs between investment timing technical debt and customer experience informing executive decision making with precision rather than intuition.

• Technical Depth and Influence Understand system architectures deeply enough to challenge engineering teams spot risks in technical proposals and drive simplification across a portfolio that spans ML inference pipelines agent orchestration frameworks desktop streaming protocols and distributed infrastructure. Evaluate capacity plans scaling signals and architecture trade offs with confidence. Influence design decisions across service teams to unblock innovation accelerate delivery and ensure that science driven capabilities translate into production impact.

About the team

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.



Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Staff Tech Portfolio Manager to lead enterprise Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) programs that improve developer productivity, platform reliability, operational readiness, and business delivery. This role partners across Engineering, Architecture, Product, Security, Risk, Finance, Operations, and application teams to translate platform strategy into actionable roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable execution.

Lead cross-functional planning, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery for high-impact PaaS platform programs, ensuring alignment across platform services, consuming application teams, and enterprise priorities.

Experience with PaaS capabilities such as container platforms, messaging, workflow orchestration, API management, file exchange, databases, caching, identity, certificate management, monitoring, and infrastructure automation.

title: Principal Software Engineer – SRE, Incident Response & Operational Excellence
location: San Diego, California, United States | Mountain View, California, United States
description:
Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the people and communities we serve. Our public-facing products — TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp — serve approximately 100 million customers who depend on us at the moments that matter most: filing a return before the deadline, running payroll, checking their credit, or sending a campaign. When something breaks, minutes matter, and how quickly and how well we recover is a direct expression of our customer promise.

We are hiring Principal Software Engineers to serve as Technical Duty Officers (TDOs) — the leaders who take command of Intuit’s most critical incidents. During our most critical incidents you hold ultimate authority on decisions and enforcement of our incident principles, partnering with the Business Unit Driver and the Incident Operations Center (IOC) to direct recovery, actions, and communications on the bridge. Reporting to the Director of Cloud Engineering & Operations, this is a dedicated, full-time role: when you are not on the bridge, your mandate is to make the next incident shorter, rarer, and better understood — partnering across every business unit on effective observability, clarity of customer workflows and their real-time impact signals, high-quality runbooks, and validated escalation and notification readiness.


This role is equal parts operator, engineer, and leader. You bring the calm, decisive command presence to lead senior leaders through high-stakes ambiguity, the deep systems intuition to cut to the most likely fault and the fastest safe path to recovery, and the engineering skills to implement the improvements you identify rather than hand them off. As a Principal engineer, you will not just execute this work manually but direct, orchestrate, and govern AI agents to accelerate detection, triage, impact assessment, and post-incident learning, accountable for the quality and reliability of everything you and those agents produce.


Responsibilities


  • Lead Intuit’s most critical incidents, serve as the “Technical Duty Officer” role on all significant incidents, holding ultimate authority on decisions and enforcement of incident principles; direct recovery, actions, and communications on the bridge in partnership with the BU Driver and IOC Leader

  • Drive fast recovery, bias the bridge toward mitigation over diagnosis, make timely and decisive calls on rollbacks, failovers, traffic shifts, and feature disablement, and keep responders focused on the shortest safe path to restoring the customer experience

  • Get the priority right early, challenge and correct incident priority based on customer impact during active response rather than after recovery, and ensure the right leaders, escalations, and communications are engaged at the right time

  • Establish clear customer-impact signals, partner with each business unit to define, instrument, and continuously report real-time customer impact for the highest-value workflows across top revenue-generating products, and drive readiness validation through the company-wide Customer Impact Gameday

  • Raise the observability bar, partner with platform and product teams on SLOs, dashboards, alerting, and tracing so responders can assess the problem and its impact in minutes; feed tool and product-gap findings from live incidents back to platform teams as part of the RCA

  • Own runbook and workflow clarity, ensure critical customer workflows have accurate, exercised runbooks and clear service ownership, and drive the recurring validation of notification channels, escalation policies, bridge creation, and executive notification workflows

  • Make communications actionable, work with the IOC Leader so that executive and customer-facing updates consistently convey customer impact, recovery progress, and next steps with enough clarity for confident decision-making

  • Lead post-incident learning, drive blameless RCAs for the incidents you command, identify systemic and cross-BU remediation, and track high-leverage actions to closure

  • Continuously improve incident and observability capabilities, bring an SRE mindset to the incident-management and observability platforms, implement solutions yourself, and encode triage, impact-assessment, and communication knowledge into agentic and self-service tooling so standards travel with the automation

  • Provide 24x7 coverage, participate in the follow-the-sun TDO rotation across the US and IDC, including off-hours and peak-season (e.g., tax deadline, payroll) readiness windows, with clean shift handoffs

  • Coach and scale incident leadership, contribute to Incident Commander training for Directors, Distinguished Engineers, and Vice Presidents, mentor BU Drivers and responders on the bridge, and raise the incident-leadership bar across the company


Qualifications


  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent work-related experience; 12+ years of engineering experience, including significant time operating large-scale, high-traffic production systems

  • Proven track record commanding large-scale incidents in an enterprise-level or financial-services environment, with the ability to lead senior leaders, make decisive calls with incomplete information, and remain calm and clear under pressure

  • Deep operational excellence and SRE expertise, including SLOs and error budgets, observability (metrics, logs, traces), alerting design, on-call and escalation practices (e.g., PagerDuty), and formal incident-management frameworks and change management

  • Broad, hands-on distributed-systems intuition across the full stack — cloud infrastructure (AWS), Kubernetes and service meshes, networking and edge (CDN, DNS, TLS), data stores, and messaging — with the ability to reason quickly about failure modes, blast radius, and the fastest safe path to recovery

  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical state into crisp customer-impact and business-impact terms for executives and customer-facing teams, in writing and live on a bridge

  • A software engineer who can build, not just operate: proficient in scripting and development (e.g., Python, Golang, Java), Infrastructure as Code, and automation, able to implement or oversee the observability, runbook, and escalation improvements you identify

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.
